text: I can choose a TTL by estimating worst-case staleness and the database load it creates.
I can list every cached key a single row change affects and say how each gets invalidated.
I can use a namespace version to invalidate a whole group of keys without scanning.
I can draw the timeline where a concurrent reader writes a stale value back into the cache, for both delete-first and update-first orders.
I can explain, with a two-writer timeline, why deleting the key on write is safer than updating it.
